name: @atlasauth/pca-fndsa-wasm
description: FN-DSA (Falcon, FIPS 206) signature backend for @atlasauth/pca: FN-DSA-512 / FN-DSA-1024 keygen, signing and verification from the vetted pure-Rust fn-dsa crate family (Thomas Pornin) compiled to WebAssembly. Verification is the PCA verifier's public-key operation.

scripts.build:wasm: cd crate && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/pca_fndsa_wasm.wasm ../wasm/pca_fndsa_wasm.wasm && cargo clean
